limits: Original x86 in isolated Unicorn;physical allocator/locks/TLS/atomics/millisecond clock adapted. No original process or physical audio device.

Actual B09A90 manager and B09BF0 object100/node12 allocation/constructor. Declared test IDs123+193*i collide in one native bucket;source position is explicitly supplied zero through B09FE0. Manager0x328 storage,request IDs,priorityzero,query manager and event producer remain provided. Not a historical application event dispatch.

Original B19E30 listener initialization newly executed before output and voices. Empty callback registry36 and engine context64,path table32 supplied. Control notification pool1280bytes/64slots is initialized by AF3810 and worker pool10240bytes/512slots by B1C100. Up to80 active B06950 calls per media;stop after first positive frame and one following frame,minimum2. Output samples measured;positive audible mix is not assumed. Original B06950 with full post-chain;clock adapter advances by actual device period21ms; CPUID uses Unicorn CPU model. AF3810/B0F550 execute with memory readiness,stream marker and fallback kind3 supplied. Common B05810/B06020 and transition AF5450/AF5950 execute in allocations made by the physical allocator;their global publication remains supplied. Native worker start B089A0 is not executed. COM/event/critical-section/atexit transports are adapters;COM enumerator and AddRef/Release/notification registration are supplied physical interfaces,not a Windows COM object. The earlier unavailable-class path reached unprovided dependency on the alternative notification path and remains separately recorded. No application bootstrap or physical time/device. Zero-quota case exercised before each media.

Stop request B17E00,frame unregister/B0CC40 and AF3AA0 execute original cleanup. One-shot960byte parent allocation refusal preserves notification allocation and is cleaned. Banks,Init,outputs,graph capacities/managers remain live;no global teardown.
31 resident ambient media only;streaming,seek/loop,generation,concurrency,device timing,other locales and full current integration remain open.

AF3810/B0F550 and actual common/transition constructors execute in the composed harness. Whole AEA640 and AEA9D0 callers are only statically analyzed. Global publication of common/transition pointers remains supplied;bank loading order is not the historical application boot sequence.

Memory-ready1,stream marker,kind3 and COM interface explicitly supplied. Native CPUID observes Unicorn model. Control64/job512 pools are native but no worker is started. Real event handles,COM object,Windows notification integration and concurrency remain unqualified.
